findings.text: the deployment guide still states the committed tuning carries speculative_dspark_block_size = 5, which this change makes false for the operator who reads the guide before launching; the file is outside the reviewed node's fence and the node reported it as a follow-on, but it is now false documentation and needs its own node.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against base 56fc2401 commit by commit; 7510dc0b moves the profile default from 5 to 3 with a comment carrying the live A/B, moves the two pinning assertions in tests/test_agent_pool_and_hicache.py:35,58, and moves the two sweep-override requested values to 4 and 5 (tests/test_agent_sweep_options.py:329,352) so they stay distinct from the new default 3 rather than colliding with it; b81f8d24 adds the §14 landing comment at docs/plans/local-lane-admission-control.html:1084 and the cumulative anchor at docs/evidence/archive/local-lane-admission-control-landed.html:1737-1775, with the launch-root caveat, the negative control and no figure.
item_verdicts.done_when: the profile value and its comment (imas_ambix/agent/profiles/deepseek-v4-1-flash.toml:203-210 carry the required figures), the test-pin clause (no test outside the two updated files references the block size), the 35-test gate and whole-tree ruff (both exit 0 at the head), and the negative control (its red log's first line repeats the declared mutation verbatim) all hold; the launch-root clause does not hold in the tree under test, because imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py:22 and :134 derive the generated script's root from Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2], so a worktree run carries 7 ".reckon-worktrees" references by construction and the main-checkout run that renders 0 required an explicit --dspark-block-size 3 override, leaving no single run that satisfies both halves of the clause as written.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is DSpark depth 3 as the deepseek-v4-1-flash profile default; at b81f8d24 imas_ambix/agent/profiles/deepseek-v4-1-flash.toml:210 declares speculative_dspark_block_size = 3 while :202 keeps speculative_algorithm = "DSPARK", and the revision's recorded dry-run renders "--speculative-dspark-block-size 3" once and "5" zero times.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the manifest (written 2026-09-26 16:31 +0200, about 37 minutes after the 15:54 dispatch); its commits 7510dc0b and b81f8d24 equal the reviewed worktree's log with a clean tree, its gate line matches gate-final.log (rev b81f8d24, 35 passed, exit 0), its dry-run counts reproduce on re-grep (worktree: 1 "3", 0 "5", 1 flag line and 7 ".reckon-worktrees"; main: 1 "3", 0 "5", 0 ".reckon-worktrees"), its negative_control_note matches negative-control.log:279-282 ("3 failed, 29 passed"), and its follow_ons correctly name the stale deployment guide.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's seven declared paths against git show --stat of both commits; the five changed paths (the profile, two test files, the plan HTML and the cumulative evidence HTML) all sit inside the fence, tests/test_agent_lane_sglang.py and docs/figures/local-lane-admission-control are fenced but unused, and the cumulative evidence record gained 42 lines with zero deletions.

justifications.durability: restoring the profile to 5 reddens the profile assertion (tests/test_agent_pool_and_hicache.py:35), the render assertion (:58) and the sweep default assertion (tests/test_agent_sweep_options.py:361), as the node's own red log shows at negative-control.log:279-282, and the override tests keep discriminating because their requested values 4 and 5 stay distinct from the default 3, so dropping the override call at imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:308 reddens them too.
justifications.evidence: gate-final.log records rev b81f8d24 with 35 passed and exit 0, and my re-run at that head reproduces 35 passed and a clean ruff (gate-at-head.log); the done_when's launch-root clause has no run in the reviewed tree, because imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py:134 makes it disagree with that tree by construction, so it rests on a main-checkout run driven by an explicit override (dryrun-main.log) rather than on the profile default.
justifications.fit: the added comment at imas_ambix/agent/profiles/deepseek-v4-1-flash.toml:203 follows the file's existing "# MEASURED <date>" annotation idiom at :119, and no added name, comment or docstring carries a plan label or a version suffix.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the recorded and re-run dry-run at the same revision renders "--speculative-dspark-block-size 3" and never "5".
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 56fc2401..b81f8d24 names five paths, all inside the manifest's fenced list, and docs/evidence/archive/local-lane-admission-control-landed.html gained 42 lines with zero deletions.
